title: Colorful Canyons
description: The Lady of the Wind rock formation glows in the sunlight in Lower Antelope Canyon near Page, Arizona. Antelope Canyon is located on Navajo Indian Tribal Lands and is frequented by hikers and photographers alike who are eager to explore the slot canyon, which is a narrow gorge with high walls consisting of soft rock. This geological feature is a result of thousands of years of water erosion.
translated_description: 亚利桑那州佩奇市附近的下羚羊峡谷中，风之女士岩层在阳光下熠熠生辉。羚羊峡谷位于纳瓦霍印第安部落领地，吸引着众多徒步旅行者和摄影爱好者前来探索这条狭缝型峡谷——它是由柔软岩石构成的高耸崖壁夹峙而成的狭窄沟壑。这一地质奇观是数千年水流侵蚀作用的成果。
